description: This file defines mock classes for DNS mDNS socket factory and datagram server socket used in testing network components within the Chromium project. It includes mock methods for socket operations and simulates network behavior for unit tests.

classes.name: MockMDnsDatagramServerSocket
classes.description: A mock implementation of DatagramServerSocket for testing DNS mDNS datagram socket behavior.

classes.name: MockMDnsSocketFactory
classes.description: A mock factory class for creating and managing mock mDNS sockets in tests.

methods.name: CreateSockets
methods.description: Creates mock socket instances and adds them to the provided vector.

methods.name: SimulateReceive
methods.description: Simulates receiving a network packet for testing purposes.

methods.name: OnSendTo
methods.description: Mock method to simulate sending data over the socket.
